Verify Retry persists after close/reopen, New/Capture show in-inspector progress + completion feedback, captured window/app summary updates, and multiple Workspace keys keep independent selected workspace IDs. Keep this product out of Marketplace submission/ship until that hardware QA is explicitly accepted.
